source_policy: Original patient wording; NCCP controls Irish treatment scope and schedules. Uploaded NCCN guide is education only. Current product supplements are labelled. No numeric survival forecast is supplied.

sources.name: Stupp 2005 EORTC/NCIC
sources.interpretation: Concurrent/adjuvant temozolomide improved survival in the randomised trial; do not transfer to recurrent monotherapy.

sources.name: Perry 2017
sources.interpretation: Short-course RT plus temozolomide improved survival in older trial participants. Trial eligibility and treatment duration do not rewrite the current NCCP indication or six-cycle plan.

sources.name: Buckner 2016 RTOG 9802
sources.interpretation: Evidence for RT followed by six PCV cycles in selected higher-risk grade II glioma; historical classification limits generalisation.

sources.name: Shaw 2012 original RTOG 9802 methods
sources.interpretation: Original methods explicitly use eight-week cycles. No trial survival number is applied to 42-day PCV or its recurrent high-grade setting.
